component.name: Swift Explorer
component.summary: File manager in the style of the Windows 11 File Explorer

description.p: Swift Explorer looks and behaves like the Windows 11 File Explorer: tabs in the title bar, an address bar with breadcrumbs, a navigation pane and the same keyboard shortcuts.
Folders are read on background threads, so large ones open without freezing the window, and search runs across subfolders in parallel.
Color schemes, and copies that are safe to unplug when they finish.

ul.li: View > Theme has Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Everforest, Nord, Dracula, Tokyo Night, Rosé Pine and Solarized.
A copy or move finishes only after the files reach the disk, and a message says when the drive can be removed.
Moving to another drive deletes the originals only after that.
On Windows, files can be dragged onto a window that sits on top of Swift Explorer or was brought forward with Alt+Tab.

description.p: Japanese text lines up with Latin letters in file names and labels.

ul.li: German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Japanese, picked from the system language or from View > Language.
Chinese, Japanese and Korean file names display with the system's CJK fonts.
The keyboard shortcuts window shows the version and a link to the project page.

description.p: Flatpak package, an install script for Linux, and faster startup.

ul.li: Typing cmd, powershell or terminal in the address bar opens a terminal in the current folder.
Uses the GNOME interface font and shows the right icon on Wayland.
Large folders sort faster, and network drives no longer freeze the window.
